Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';
import 'package:xberg/src/xberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final input = await createExtractInputFromJson(json: '{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/plain","uri":"https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt"}');
    final config = await createExtractionConfigFromJson(json: '{"chunking":{"chunker_type":"text","max_chars":300,"max_overlap":40,"trim":true}}');
    final result = await XbergBridge.extract(input, config: config);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].chunks);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
